column1: Check type, location, mounting elevation and mounting details of all light fixtures, light switches and convenience receptacles in the plant.
Check location, size, enclosure type, mounting elevation and mounting details of all lighting and distribution panels.
Detail check contents of all above mentioned panels against the drawings.
Check all individual circuit breakers for correct size.
Check size, type, location and mounting details of all lighting/ distribution transformer.
Check grounding of the above transformers and distribution panels.
Check lighting conduit and cable runs, their supports, junction boxes, conduit fittings and cable connectors.
Before energization, check all wiring for correct circuit, size of conductors, neutrals and grounds and labelling of wires.
Check correct labelling of all circuits in all lighting/distribution panels.
Check for correct nameplates on transformers and panels.
Test operation of photocells and associated contactors.
